canonical_project: Uttar Pradesh planned data center cluster - Prayagraj
owner: Multiple prospective investors / Government of Uttar Pradesh
notes: ETDatacenters and The Statesman report that Uttar Pradesh is exploring/proposing data center investments across Noida, Yamuna Expressway region, Lucknow, Varanasi, Prayagraj, Meerut, and Sitapur. The reports cite a state-level pipeline of 5,410 MW potential proposals and 644 MW committed capacity statewide, but do not allocate capacity or name a specific Prayagraj facility/developer.
